payload.rationale: Brief journey_stage is 'planning' and service_link is /wonderland-concierge, so per services.md the primary goal is a Wedded Concierge consultation, with the magazine as the early-stage magnet. All four tracked links already exist once each with utm_medium=content, primary before secondary, every concierge anchor reads 'Wedded Concierge', and both targets are in the link map, so no link, marker or copy is added and 08-final.md is untouched. Both concierge links in the body sit after the legal side is framed as the couple's (celebrant and registry at home, or the destination's own authorities), so neither implies the Advisor handles legal paperwork. Panel cta_reactions: three readers said 'maybe' and two 'no' (weighted enquiry 1.7); what they want to see first is the fee model, commissions, deposits, a phone call with a person and on-the-day contact, all deferred business details that belong on /wonderland-concierge and are logged for the run report. The one approved answer to the money worry, 'the fee is agreed in writing before any work begins', already precedes the closing CTA and is used as the primary subtext. Subtexts use only brand-facts 'Claims we can make'.
